title: Was not a set of four
text: Was not a set of four. While the bucket seems nice and like it will last, we did not receive a set of four as advertised. I wouldn't pay this price for one storage box.

product_metadata.title: HOMZ 31 Quart Medium Clear Plastic Holiday Storage Container Bin with Latching Handles and Removable Ornament Dividers, (4 Pack)
features: Medium, 31-quart storage containers ideal for holiday decorations like ornaments, trinkets, and more
Bins are made from durable and see-through plastic that withstands ongoing use
Lid snaps onto the base of the container latching handle that also allows for easy carrying; Clear base with a red lid and green latching handles
Containers nest and stack nicely together to maximize your space for efficient storage; Included dividers help keep ornaments organized and protected from breaking
Exterior dimensions (L x W x H): 16.25 x 13 x 12.125; Interior dimensions (L x W x H): 12.1 x 11.09 x 11.44; Color: Clear Base, Red Lid; Weight: 2.50 pounds
description: This Medium 31 Quart storage container with dividers is designed with the user in mind; featuring ergonomic handles for convenient transporting. They are ideal for safely organizing and storing all your holiday ornaments. The container with dividers can store up to 36 ornaments. Stack multiple containers on top of one another and save valuable storage space or nest them when not in use. Neatly store all your holiday decorations and ornaments in a convenient and organized fashion. The see-through design keeps contents visible making it easy to find the decorations you need for the holidays. Large latches secure the lid at both ends ensure a sealed fit and make the container easy to identify with a red lid and green latches. Made in the USA.
